'''Raenna D'maechio''' was an [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of the [[S.A.T Artisan Sect]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Raenna D'maechio]]
Raenna D'maechio was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
